evidence.title: NSW police commissioner made last-minute bid to hold closed-door hearings into Sydney anti-Herzog protest

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC Operation Makalu terms of reference
occurrences.quote_span: It said its Operation Makalu inquiry would analyse the use of OC spray, as well as the “improper use of arrest powers and the police use of force” at the protest.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC counsel assisting submissions and procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: The counsel assisting submitted that public examinations were necessary because “there was already significant information concerning the events of 9 February 2026 in the public domain, including footage of use of force by police” and that senior police officers had advanced in public an “official narrative of what took place”.
occurrences.speaker: Counsel assisting the Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC hearing schedule
occurrences.quote_span: On Thursday, the watchdog said its inquiry into the protest would begin with a public address by counsel assisting on 19 October, followed by five weeks of private hearings.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC decision on Operation Makalu hearing procedures
occurrences.quote_span: “The timing of these issues being raised by the Commissioner of Police is more than regrettable given its impact on the orderly progress of the investigation, the preparation for examinations and the efficient and effective use of public resources by both the Commission and the NSWPF and the associated cost and disruption flowing from the delay,” Johnson said.
occurrences.speaker: Peter Johnson SC
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: “Public comments made by senior police increase the need for independent scrutiny,” the commissioner wrote.
occurrences.speaker: Peter Johnson SC
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC Operation Makalu terms of reference
occurrences.quote_span: It will consider police planning ahead of the protest and “any opportunities for improvement in the policing of protests”.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: In his decision, the commissioner determined that private examinations would be held on “issues of fact” while public examinations would be held to deal with systemic issues, but only after the private examinations have been held.
occurrences.speaker: Peter Johnson SC
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: NSW Police statement
occurrences.quote_span: NSW police said in a statement it acknowledged the decision to hold private hearings and awaited the findings.
occurrences.speaker: NSW police
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC hearing schedule and procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: Johnson said the start date of public hearings, 21 September, was subsequently delayed to “a date to be fixed” to allow a private hearing for submissions on the issue.
occurrences.speaker: Peter Johnson SC
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Lanyon legal submissions to LECC
occurrences.quote_span: They argued that the Lecc Act does not have the power to hear “broad ranging open submissions” and said Lecc should not take the “unconventional approach of hearing opening submissions in public part way through an investigation that is already underway”.
occurrences.speaker: Legal representatives for Mal Lanyon
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: NSW Police statement
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement following Johnson’s comments, NSW police said it “complied with the requirements of the LECC Act in a cooperative manner”.
occurrences.speaker: NSW police
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC decision on Operation Makalu hearing procedures
occurrences.quote_span: In a decision made public on Thursday, the Lecc chief commissioner, Peter Johnson SC, revealed that legal representatives for Lanyon had indicated for the “first time” on 9 September that he wished to be heard on the issue of public and private examinations.
occurrences.speaker: Peter Johnson SC
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC hearing schedule and procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: The bid was made less than two weeks before the public hearings between September and November were due to start.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Sue Higginson statement
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement, NSW Greens justice spokesperson, Sue Higginson, described the push to hold hearings in private as “an extraordinary attempt by the police to suppress the public examination of allegations of serious misconduct by uniformed police officers, and to prevent public scrutiny of the political decisions and command structures that led to police violence against protesters”.
occurrences.speaker: Sue Higginson
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC Operation Makalu inquiry records and hearing schedule
occurrences.quote_span: The Law Enforcement Conduct Commission (Lecc) has said that its inquiry into the February protest at Sydney’s town hall, launched after widespread allegations of police brutality, would go ahead this month with a mix of public and private examinations, saying the timing of issues raised by police commissioner, Mal Lanyon, was “regrettable”.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: Lanyon legal submissions to LECC
occurrences.quote_span: Lawyers acting on behalf of Lanyon submitted that Lecc’s opening address and the examination of witnesses should occur in private and not be livestreamed.
occurrences.speaker: Legal representatives for Mal Lanyon
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC submissions and procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: But Lecc argued that it does have the power to decide when public examinations are appropriate.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC hearing schedule and transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Lecc expects senior officers will then appear at public examinations.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC procedural decision and hearing schedule
occurrences.quote_span: The New South Wales police commissioner made a last-minute bid to hold hearings into Sydney’s anti-Herzog protest behind closed doors, delaying the inquiry, the police watchdog has revealed.
occurrences.speaker: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry

occurrences.checkable_against: LECC counsel assisting submissions and procedural decision
occurrences.quote_span: The counsel assisting had pointed to specific features of the investigation as reason for why only private examinations were not appropriate. This included the “significant public concern” after the protest, including in parts of the Islamic community in Western Sydney.
occurrences.speaker: Counsel assisting the Law Enforcement Conduct Commission
occurrences.subject: Law Enforcement Conduct Commission Operation Makalu inquiry
